description: This file defines the 'Image' class, an interface for objects that render image data or pictorial information on screen, including methods to get image extents, position, size, description, and locale.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: An interface for objects that render image data or pictorial information to the screen, providing methods to retrieve image extents, position, size, description, and locale.

methods.name: getImageExtents
methods.description: Obtains a bounding box that entirely contains the image contents as displayed on screen.

methods.name: getImagePosition
methods.description: Gets the coordinates of the current image position on screen.

methods.name: getImageSize
methods.description: Obtains the width and height of the current onscreen view of the image.

methods.name: get_imageDescription
methods.description: Returns a textual description of what is visually depicted in the image.

methods.name: get_imageLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale used by the image description.
